lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines on the primary torso, with relatively uniform spacing becoming slightly wider at the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 7th vertical line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 is truncated at the base of the neck; lines 9 and 10 are highly abbreviated segments that do not reach the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 high-contrast circular spots is located on the posterior haunch above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The 3 spots on the haunch are horizontally aligned to form a semi-connected geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the nasal bridge, two white spots on the lower cheek, and a large white patch at the ventral base of the neck.
